evidence.quote: we decided today to raise the target rate for the federal funds rate by ¼ percentage point, bringing it to 1½ to 1¾ percent.
In the Committee’s view, further gradual increases in the federal funds rate will best promote these goals.
Indeed, the economic outlook has strengthened in recent months.
there’s no sense in the data that we’re on the cusp of an acceleration of inflation.
Barring a very significant and unexpected weakening in the outlook, we do not intend to alter this program.
So we’re trying to take that middle ground
